## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `6fea0ab67c6adc460776a2750d60a55faa312323`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/plugin-report/package.json (exports), ui/packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (11 locales), .changeset/36374-report-builder.md + ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/ReportBuilder.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/reportBuilderModel.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportBuilderHost.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/reportBuilderArrival.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appRouteMetadataReads.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Read: the net diff `origin/main...6fea0ab67` (27 files), card #36374 body and comments, the PR #36644 body, and the 39 check-runs on the head. At reading time `Check Changeset`, the Lint, Type Check and E2E UI jobs were `in_progress`; `Check PR Size`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` were `success`. No check had failed yet. Security-touching is `yes` for one reason only: `ReportNewPage.tsx` adds a client-side admin-only gate on the new `reports/new` route, the same gate the existing 「Edit」 button uses. The server-side write authority (the `/meta` save and publish doors) is unchanged.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Declared vs exported, `@object-ui/plugin-report`.** `package.json` has a single `"."` entry, so `src/index.tsx` is the whole public surface. The diff adds these to the index: `ReportBuilder`; the types `ReportBuilderProps`, `ReportBuilderTextBox`, `ReportBuilderDataset`, `ReportBuilderMeasure`, `ReportBuilderDimension`, `ReportBuilderMembers`, `ReportBuilderMissing`, `ReportBuilderSection` and `ReportDraft`; and three **value** exports, `REPORT_BUILDER_CHART_TYPES`, `reportBuilderMissingPiece` (aliasing `missingPiece`) and `reportBuilderPickDataset` (aliasing `pickDataset`). The declaration says "`ReportBuilder` and its model types". The type exports match it. **should-fix:** the three value exports are published without being declared, and nothing in the tree uses them: `git grep` at the head finds them only in `index.tsx` and `builder/`. `ReportBuilderHost` imports only `ReportBuilder`, `ReportDraft` and `DatasetDrillArgs`. The fix is either to name them on the `Clause-②:` line in the PR body and the changeset, or to drop them from the index until #36364 needs them.
- **`foldTableUnderChart`.** It is optional and boolean, and the declaration matches it. The fold applies only when `!crossTab` and the chart plan is `series` or `single_value`. The table stays mounted (`hidden`), so export still writes it, as the jsdoc says.
- **i18n.** Each of the 11 locales gets the same 55 added lines (`report.computedValues` and `report.builder.*`). No locale removes a line. This matches the declaration.
- **`ReportDraft` is a string-keyed record of `unknown` values.** It is a loose published type rather than `ReportSchema`. The comment says this is on purpose. Noted as a nit only: once it is published, narrowing it later becomes a contract change.

### ② Semver level

- **must-fix.** `.changeset/36374-report-builder.md` grades `@object-ui/plugin-report`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` all as `minor`, and the same changeset and the PR body declare `Metadata-protocol: none`. `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (`judgeLevel`, around L2052-2057) returns `none-minor` whenever `none` is declared and any introduced entry is `minor` or above, and that case exits 1 (around L2355-2375). The workflow prose (`pr-automation.yml`, "WHICH LEVEL") says the same thing: the console, `feat:`, and non-authorable types under `none` are `patch`. Nothing in the diff changes what a metadata author can write: there is no spec, schema or authorable-baseline change, and the new keys are UI catalogue strings and runtime component props. So `none` is the right declaration and the three entries must be `patch`. `Check Changeset` was still `in_progress` on the head when read, but on a static reading it will fail.
- **Breaking-ness.** No existing export or prop was removed or narrowed. The `index.tsx` hunk only adds lines, the new prop is optional, and the i18n hunks only add keys. So no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Existing exports and props.** No breaking change.
- **Default behaviour of `DatasetReportRenderer`.** `foldTableUnderChart` is off by default (`!!undefined` is false). The only caller that turns it on is `ReportBuilder.tsx`, and `ReportView` never sets it. The report page's renderer is unchanged.
- **Default behaviour of the report page (declared, card-mandated).** 「Edit」 now opens the full-page builder for every dataset-bound report (`opensInBuilder`). Only `joined` and pre-dataset reports (`objectName` / `dataSource` / `data`) keep the inspector panel. The card asks for exactly this (要做的 1). **nit:** a dataset-bound report that also uses `columns` (a cross-tab), `order`, `runtimeFilter` or several `values` loses its console editor for those keys. The builder keeps them on every pick except a data-source switch, but offers no control for them and no way back to the panel. 「＋ 筛选」 is declared as not built. Studio remains the path.
- **Save path.** It agrees with the ruling. `ReportView.saveSchema` (used by both builder and panel) and `ReportNewPage.handleSave` both call `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`, which stages the draft with `ifNoneMatch: '*'`, publishes, and on a refused publish discards the draft it wrote. A `409` draft conflict resolves `pending-draft` before anything is written. Both callers then toast `report.builder.pendingDraft` and return `false`, so the builder stays open with its edit. That is "save once, live at once", with nothing written over a pending draft. The inspector panel's save becomes save-and-publish too. That is declared ("for the builder and the inspector panel alike") and is covered by the epic #36510 ruling quoted in the PR body. **nit:** the changeset and PR body say "a draft *someone else* left pending", but the door refuses any pending draft, including one the saving admin left earlier. The behaviour is the safe one; only the wording is narrower than the code.
- **New id materialisation (should-fix).** `ReportNewPage.newReportName` derives the identifier from the label on the client and makes it unique only against the console's `reports` list. The write it then makes, `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`, pins only the **draft** layer (`ifNoneMatch: '*'` refuses only a pending draft). So a published report with the same name that the list does not hold is overwritten and published at once, with no prompt. That can happen when the list was read before another admin's create, or when the name is held in a package the served list does not show. For a create, the door should refuse an existing name of any layer (a create-only pin or an existence check at the server), or the PR should state why the client list is authoritative. There is no app-side join. The builder fetches no rows itself: the preview goes through `DatasetReportRenderer`'s existing dataset query, and the catalog and members come from the existing `useDatasetCatalog` / `useDatasetSemantics` hooks. So no SQL push-down finding.
- **Builder model fidelity (should-fix).** In `reportBuilderModel.ts`, `reconcile` always rewrites `chart.yAxis = values[0]` and `chart.xAxis = rows[0]`. But `selectedMeasure` shows `chart.yAxis` first. On an existing report whose authored `chart.yAxis` is not `values[0]` (or whose `xAxis` is not `rows[0]`), the first grouping or chart-type pick silently switches the charted measure (or axis) away from the one the picker shows, and Save then publishes that switch to everyone. The fix is to reconcile from the measure the builder shows (`selectedMeasure`) rather than `values[0]`, or to normalise once on open. The showcase report the PR body's browser run used (`showcase_hours_by_status_chart`) is consistent, so that run would not have caught this.
- **Write-refusal census (nit).** `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts` drops the `ReportView.saveSchema` row because `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` is not in `SEAM_WRITES`. So neither of the two new report write sites (`ReportView.saveSchema` and `ReportNewPage.handleSave`) is counted by the census. Both do surface a refusal (a toast with `formatMetadataError`), and `ReportView.saveRefusal-11583.test.tsx` pins one of them. The census population could take this door, as a follow-up.
- **Arrival landing.** `reportBuilderArrival.ts` uses navigation state only, is read once per `location.key`, and is cleared with `replace`, so a shared or reloaded URL never opens the builder. No concern.
- **Card acceptance.** Not built, as declared in the PR body: 「＋ 筛选」, 「显示数量为 0 的分组」, 「和上一期对比」, and the 3-month preset the card asks for (the period chip reuses the existing presets). These are recorded narrowings, not contract findings.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-bkjint`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e1bb43f45b4f251df2860e45d11e134063c8da92`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/plugin-report/package.json (exports), ui/packages/plugin-report/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (11 locales), .changeset/36374-report-builder.md + ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/ReportBuilder.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-report/src/builder/reportBuilderModel.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportBuilderHost.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/reportBuilderArrival.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appRouteMetadataReads.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts, ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Round 2. This reviews the rework head `e1bb43f45` (commits `ac9fd9beb` and `e1bb43f45`, on top of `6fea0ab67`, which was FAILed in round 1). I read the delta `6fea0ab67..e1bb43f45` (20 files) and the net diff against `origin/main` where I needed it. The live PR body and head are `e1bb43f45`. Check-runs at reading time: 43 on the head. `Check Changeset`, Type Check UI, Lint UI and E2E UI were `in_progress`. `Type Check · workspace`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `PR-body guards` were `success`. One duplicate `PR-body guards` run was `cancelled`, superseded by a later green run. Nothing had failed. Security-touching stays `yes` for one reason only: `ReportNewPage.tsx` puts a client-side admin-only gate on `reports/new`, the same gate as the existing 「Edit」. The server's write authority is unchanged.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Round 1 should-fix (undeclared value exports): resolved.** The `export { REPORT_BUILDER_CHART_TYPES, missingPiece as reportBuilderMissingPiece, pickDataset as reportBuilderPickDataset }` block is removed from `src/index.tsx`. At the head, the published surface (`package.json` has a single `"."` entry) adds `ReportBuilder`, plus types only: `ReportBuilderProps`, `ReportBuilderTextBox`, `ReportBuilderDataset`, `ReportBuilderMeasure`, `ReportBuilderDimension`, `ReportBuilderMembers`, `ReportBuilderMissing`, `ReportBuilderSection` and `ReportDraft`. Neither the new `ReportBuilderMissingReason` union nor `REPORT_BUILDER_CHART_TYPES` came back into the index. `ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` reads both straight from `packages/plugin-report/src/builder/reportBuilderModel.ts` as `DYNAMIC_KEY_FAMILIES` vocabularies (`array` and `union`), so the i18n gate's registration does not publish anything. `ReportBuilderMissing.reason` is now typed through that unexported union. That is structurally the same literal union as before, so the published `ReportBuilderMissing` type is unchanged. The PR body's `Clause-②:` line now says "no value exports besides the component", which matches.
- **`foldTableUnderChart`.** No change since round 1: optional, boolean, off by default.
- **i18n.** The delta adds `report.builder.nameTaken` to all 11 locales (one line each), and no locale loses a line. This is still within the declared `report.builder.*`.

### ② Semver level

- **Round 1 must-fix (`minor` under `Metadata-protocol: none`): resolved.** `.changeset/36374-report-builder.md` now grades `@object-ui/plugin-report`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` as `patch`. It and the PR body still declare `Metadata-protocol: none`. `judgeLevel` in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` reaches `none-clean` on that pair: no entry is `minor` or above, and the diff moves no authorable-surface or authorable-defaults baseline, since there is no `packages/spec` change. `Check Changeset` was still `in_progress` when I read it. This is a static reading.
- **Breaking-ness.** No existing export or prop was removed or narrowed. Patch is the right level, and no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round 1 should-fix (new id materialisation over a published report): resolved.** `ReportNewPage.freeReportName` now asks `metadataClient.get('report', candidate)` for each candidate. It moves past any name the server holds and gives up after 50 tries with `report.builder.nameTaken`. I read `MetadataClient.get` (`data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, `readItemResponse`). It returns `null` only on a 404 and throws on any other failure. So an existence read that is refused or fails lands in the `catch` and shows a save-error toast; it never writes. A name that holds only a pending draft is still caught by the save's `ifNoneMatch: '*'` pin (`pending-draft`, nothing written). **nit:** there is a check-then-write window between the `get` and the draft write. The write pins only the draft layer, so a concurrent create under the same name, published within that window, could still be overwritten. This is narrow, and closing it fully needs a create-only server pin, which is outside this diff. There is no app-side join and no new SQL push-down concern.
- **Round 1 should-fix (builder rewrites an authored `yAxis`/`xAxis`): partly resolved; a residual stays at should-fix.** `reconcile` now keeps an authored `chart.xAxis` that is still grouped, and `pickGrouping` resets it on purpose (`picked.grouping`). That half is fixed. The measure half keeps an authored `yAxis` only when `values.includes(prev.yAxis)`. The same delta makes `opensInBuilder` send every report with more than one `values` entry to the panel. So the only reports that can now reach the builder with `yAxis` ≠ `values[0]` have `values` absent, `values: []`, or a single value different from `yAxis`. The spec allows all of these: `ReportSchema.values` is optional, and `ReportChartSchema.yAxis` is any bound-dataset measure. For all of them the guard falls through to `values[0]` / the count measure. As a result:
  - `values: ['a']` with `chart.yAxis: 'b'`: the picker shows `b`, the first chart-type or grouping pick charts `a`, and Save publishes `a` to everyone.
  - `values` absent with a `chart`: `fillDefaults` (the builder's mount effect) writes `values: [countMeasure]`, and `reconcile` then re-points `yAxis` at the count measure as soon as the builder opens. The report turns dirty with no edit.

  The new test (`reportBuilder-36374.test.tsx`, "an authored chart keeps the measure…") uses a two-value report, which `opensInBuilder` no longer sends to the builder. So it pins the case that cannot occur and misses the one that can. Fix options:
  - keep `prev.yAxis` whenever it is a string, without the `values.includes` guard, and have `fillDefaults` seed `values` from `chart.yAxis` when one is authored;
  - or extend `opensInBuilder` to keep the panel when `chart.yAxis` is set and is not `values[0]`.

  The example corpus has no such report: every dataset report in `examples/` has `yAxis` equal to `values[0]` or no chart. That is why this is a should-fix and not a must-fix.
- **Round 1 nit (dataset reports with shapes the builder cannot edit): resolved.** `opensInBuilder` now also keeps the inspector panel for non-empty `columns`, a set `runtimeFilter`, and more than one `values` entry. A new test in `ReportView.saveRefusal-11583.test.tsx` pins this. The keys the builder still has no control for are `order` and `dateRange`. `pickMeasure` and `pickGrouping` keep `order` (filtered to the members still selected), and `dateRange` is the builder's own period chip, so nothing is lost.
- **Round 1 nit ("someone else's" pending draft): resolved.** The changeset now says "Over any pending draft nothing is written". The PR body says "including one the saving admin left earlier", which matches `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`'s `409 → pending-draft` branch.
- **Save path: unchanged since round 1 and still agrees with the ruling.** `ReportView.saveSchema` (builder and panel) and `ReportNewPage.handleSave` both go through `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`: a pinned draft write, then a publish, and a refused publish discards the draft it wrote. Over any pending draft nothing is written, and the builder stays open with the reason. That is "save once, live at once".
- **Default behaviour of `DatasetReportRenderer`.** Unchanged: `foldTableUnderChart` is off by default, and only `ReportBuilder` passes it.
- **Write-refusal census (nit, carried from round 1).** `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` is still outside `SEAM_WRITES`, so neither report write site is counted by `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`. Both surface their refusal with a toast. This can be a follow-up.
- **`pickMeasure` (nit).** When the shown measure (`chart.yAxis`) is not in `values`, `values.indexOf(shown)` is `-1`. `Math.max(0, …)` then replaces `values[0]` instead of inserting the new measure. The result is still well-formed, since builder reports have at most one value, but it drops the authored `values[0]` without saying so. The should-fix above touches the same case.
- **`ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`.** It adds two `DYNAMIC_KEY_FAMILIES` rows (`report.builder.chart.*` against `REPORT_BUILDER_CHART_TYPES`, and `report.builder.missing.*` against `ReportBuilderMissingReason`). This brings the builder's template keys under the existing gate. It tightens coverage and loosens no rule, and it is not under `.claude/**`, so `Rule-change-verified: none`.

Round 3. This reviews head `2f4e522fd`, one commit on top of `e1bb43f45` (round 2, which passed with one should-fix still open). I read the delta `e1bb43f45..2f4e522fd`, which touches only `reportBuilderModel.ts` and `reportBuilder-36374.test.tsx` and confirms the claim. The net diff against `origin/main` is otherwise unchanged from round 2 (28 files). The PR's live head is `2f4e522fd`. Check-runs at reading time: 25 on the head, mostly `in_progress` or `queued`. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` was `success`. One `PR-body guards` run was `cancelled`, the same superseded-run pattern as round 2. Nothing had failed. Security-touching stays `yes` for one reason only: the client-side admin-only gate on `reports/new` in `ReportNewPage.tsx`, the same gate as the existing 「Edit」. The server's write authority is unchanged.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Unchanged from round 2.** The published surface (`package.json` has a single `"."` entry; this is `src/index.tsx`) adds `ReportBuilder` and the types `ReportBuilderProps`, `ReportBuilderTextBox`, `ReportBuilderDataset`, `ReportBuilderMeasure`, `ReportBuilderDimension`, `ReportBuilderMembers`, `ReportBuilderMissing`, `ReportBuilderSection` and `ReportDraft`. It has no other value exports, so it matches the `Clause-②:` line. The delta touches neither `index.tsx` nor any exported type. `fillDefaults` and `reconcile` are module-internal and are not published.
- `foldTableUnderChart` is optional and off by default. The i18n keys (`report.builder.*`, including `nameTaken`, and `report.computedValues`) are the same in all 11 locales. Neither is touched by this delta.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged and correct. `.changeset/36374-report-builder.md` grades `@object-ui/plugin-report`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` as `patch` under `Metadata-protocol: none`, which is `none-clean` in `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` `judgeLevel`. The delta changes no published export and no spec, so patch still holds. No breaking change, so no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round 2 should-fix (an authored `yAxis` outside `values` switched by an unrelated pick, or re-pointed on open): resolved.**
  - `reconcile` now keeps `prev.yAxis` whenever it is a string. An empty string still falls through to `values[0]`, because the expression is `keptMeasure || values[0]`.
  - `fillDefaults` now seeds `values` from an authored `chart.yAxis` before it falls back to the dataset's count measure. So a report with a chart and no `values` opens on the measure its chart draws.
  - I traced every caller of `reconcile` in the model:
    - `pickDataset` deletes `chart` first, so `prev` is empty and the new dataset starts on its count measure, as before.
    - `pickMeasure` passes `picked.measure`, which overrides the kept measure, as intended.
    - `pickGrouping` keeps the measure and resets the axis (`picked.grouping`).
    - `pickChartType` keeps both.
    - `fillDefaults` keeps the authored measure and now also lists it in `values`.
  - Nothing else re-points `yAxis`. `missingPiece` reads `selectedMeasure`, which prefers `chart.yAxis`, so a chart-only report is not reported as missing a measure. That is consistent with the seed.
  - The spec does not require `yAxis` to be in `values`: `ReportChartSchema.yAxis` is any bound-dataset measure and `ReportSchema.values` is optional. The new tests run `expectSpecValid` on `values: ['total_amount']` with `yAxis: 'deal_count'`.
  - The two new tests pin exactly the shapes round 2 named. One is `values: ['total_amount']` with `yAxis: 'deal_count'`, checked across `pickChartType`, `pickGrouping` and `pickMeasure`. The other is `values` absent, which `fillDefaults` seeds from `yAxis`. The two-value case, which can no longer reach the builder (`opensInBuilder`), was dropped from the test.
- **nit (new, small):** with `values` absent, the builder's mount effect (`fillDefaults`) now writes `values: [yAxis]` on open. The report is then dirty with no edit, and a Save without changes writes that `values` key. The chart is unchanged, and the computed-values table now shows the charted measure. This is harmless and arguably intended, and it is noted only so the dirty flag on open is not a surprise.
- **nit (new, small):** a chart-type round trip through 「表格」 (`table`) deletes `chart`. Coming back to a chart then charts `values[0]`, so an authored `yAxis` that was not in `values` does not come back. While the report is in table mode the measure picker shows `values[0]`, so what the person sees and what is charted stay in step. Nothing is switched silently.
- **nit (carried):** in `pickMeasure`, when the shown measure (`chart.yAxis`) is not in `values`, `indexOf` is `-1`, `Math.max(0, …)` makes the index `0`, and the authored `values[0]` is replaced rather than kept. That is a table value the person did not pick. Builder reports have at most one value, so the result is well-formed.
- **nit (carried):** the check-then-write window in `ReportNewPage.freeReportName`. A same-name create published between the `get` and the draft-pinned write is not refused. Closing this fully needs a create-only server pin, which is outside this diff.
- **nit (carried):** `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` is outside `SEAM_WRITES`, so the report write sites are not counted by `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`. Both show a refusal toast.
- **No regression elsewhere.** The Save path is unchanged ("save once, live at once" through `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`, and nothing is written over any pending draft). `foldTableUnderChart` still defaults off. Dataset reports with `columns`, `runtimeFilter` or several `values` still keep the inspector panel. The new-report name check against the server is unchanged. No new id materialisation, no app-side join, and no SQL push-down concern.
